adjudication.rationale: In TopicEmbed.import, the URL guard is only `return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`, which will still accept malformed URLs like ones containing spaces/illegal characters after the scheme. That URL is then passed into `absolutize_urls(url, contents)`, which calls `uri = URI(url)` without rescuing `URI::InvalidURIError`. This would raise and abort the import transaction for such feed links, matching the finding.
